corpus_crossquery.query: Which canonical and discovery statements rely on Steinberg 2021, and do its methods, panels, raw tables and peer review support their strength?
corpus_crossquery.finding: The human-organoid phenotype and reversibility proof-of-concept remain useful. GABA depolarization is an unmeasured mechanistic interpretation; the bulk RNA-seq metabolic signature is maturity/composition-confounded; final RNA-seq n is 2 WT versus 4 KO; and WWOX rescue is ubiquitous supraphysiological expression with partial rescue. DL-MECH-098 records the correction.

entries.proposition: For the TBR1 and SATB2 sub-panels of Figure 4H no WT-versus-W-AAV bracket is drawn. entries.proposition: 2026-10-21 (R2 batch, scientist-b): the lists the supplementary tables carry are defined by the authors as genes with a fold change above 1.2 (or below 1/1.2) and a P below 0.01 (that this P is unadjusted is the reader's inference from the tables: the Methods give alpha 0.01, the Figure EV3 legend names the Wald test, and CACNA1E has P 0.0097 with an adjusted P of 0.067), after a 15,370-gene tested set; so a gene absent from both lists is one that is not clearly changed under that rule, not one shown absent or unexpressed (the Fig 4 legend gives wild type n = 2 against knockout n = 4, so absence from the lists is weak evidence of no change).
